note: Adapted from the species description of Astalotermes obstructus in Sands (1972), originally in English; the species has no soldiers, only alates and workers; the comparative passage at the end of the account is merged into the diagnostic characters; measurement tables, figure numbers, type specimens and distribution records are not translated, and figures in the measurement tables that could not be recovered from OCR damage are not recorded.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The species is smaller than any other in the third group and, in both alate and worker, the first marginal tooth of the right mandible is slightly less reduced, which approaches the first and second groups in this respect. The alate is distinguished from species of those two groups by the ocelli closely adjoining the compound eyes. The worker differs from the remaining species of the third group by the distinctly necked enteric valve seat, from the second group by its small size, and from the first group by the shorter first marginal tooth of the right mandible. The alate has been confused with Apagotermes stolidus, but the meso- and metanotum are relatively broader, the postclypeus longer, and the ocelli closer to the compound eyes. The worker abdomen is indeed dehiscent.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellowish brown; pilosity yellowish brown, sparse but conspicuous by its colour. Postclypeus moderately inflated, Pcl/W 0.27–0.28, Pcl/Ri 2.21–2.38; mandibular apical tooth short, La/Li 0.58–0.61, Ra/Ri 0.71–0.76; in surface view the subsidiary tooth of the left mandible is separated from the molar ridge by a distinct notch, the composite ratio La/Li·Lm 13.90–14.83; the first marginal tooth of the right mandible lies distinctly behind the line from the apical tooth to the second marginal tooth, its anterior margin slightly more than half that of the second marginal tooth, Ra/Ri·Rm 15.09–17.90. Fore tibia weakly inflated, Ti/Tw 4.35; third apical spur small but more than one quarter the length of the other two spurs, not reduced. The midgut–hindgut junction is slightly longer than diagonal and reaches the middle of the Malpighian tubule knot; in the unopened abdomen the enteric valve seat is dorsal, weakly trilobed, the two outer lobes almost enclosing the smaller third lobe, and joined to the second hindgut pouch by a short, distinct neck; the membranous wall of the valve bears sparse minute spines beyond the cushions.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown, not darker above the ocelli; fontanelle elongate-elliptical, slightly shorter than the ocellus, slightly concave, brown; central spot short-elliptical, very small, raised on a small tubercle, dark brown; postclypeus dark brown, labrum yellowish brown; frontal mark very indistinct, flat, crescent-shaped, dark brown; antennae brown. Pronotum dark brown, meso- and metanotum brown, the dark transverse suture present only on the metanotum; femora yellowish brown, tibiae paler, tarsi yellow. Abdominal tergites brown, dorsolateral spiracles paler, sternites and ventrolateral spiracles pale brown, the median part of the sternites yellow; cerci yellow. Posterior margin of head capsule not very evenly rounded, slightly undulate behind the compound eyes; ocelli rather large, almost touching the compound eyes, the distance one quarter or less of their own minimum diameter; postclypeus weakly inflated, Pcl/W 0.23–0.26, Pcl/Ra 3.28–3.64, posterior margin obtusely angular, rounded only in the middle, median suture distinct posteriorly and absent anteriorly. Mandibular apical tooth short, La/Li 0.50–0.60, Ra/Ri 0.63–0.67; in surface view the subsidiary tooth of the left mandible just clears the molar ridge; the apical and marginal teeth of the right mandible are inserted in line, the anterior margins of the first and second marginal teeth nearly equal. Cephalic pilosity very dense, dark brown, uneven, with very strong outstanding setae, not forming a felt. Meso- and metanotum less narrowed at the constriction, M/W 0.26–0.28. Third apical spur of the fore tibia distinct, about half the length of the other two spurs.
